claim: In the matching retail DLL, Player.TransitStateAfterAnm (0x06004EC8) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 1,438-byte body. It returns unless animator.IsAnmComplete() is true; a forViewer path sets animator.isAnmPause=1 and returns. It resolves TargetPlIdx, calls PostprocessEachState, then applies an exact TerrainColType==3 / Zone==0 Ring-collision pre-branch that can store Zone=3 and call mForceFallStatus, or call mForceDropStatus and, when DownTime==255, SetStunTime(111), SetDownTime(143), isStandingStunOK=1, then return. It loads GetCurrentFormDispInfo and raw formIdx 100 or 101 dispatches to TransitStateAfterAnm_Down and returns. Otherwise it switches on animator.AnimeEnd-1 with 14 explicit targets. The exact raw AnimeEnd cases 1..14 perform the pinned state/direction/down-time/request/audience/target/auto-run/host-field effects recorded in the witness, including case 9 dispatch to TransitStateAfterAnm_AutoRun; values outside the 1..14 switch range return. FACT-0047 pins the direct call at UpdatePlayer IL+0x0066. The two large subhelpers TransitStateAfterAnm_Down and TransitStateAfterAnm_AutoRun are intentionally separate gates.
